items.name: AGO: Sunday Best: The Power & The Glory of Black Style
items.reason: Black style and self-fashioning from the 1880s to today, curated by the AGO before it goes to Philadelphia; on view 7 Oct 2026 to 28 Feb 2027 (adult admission estimated about $30).

items.name: Winterlicious opening weekend
items.reason: The city's prix-fixe restaurant festival starts 29 Jan 2027 (runs to 11 Feb); a set dinner at a place you would not normally get into, about $45 a head estimated.

items.name: Bang On A Can All-Stars: Reich and Glass at 90, Koerner Hall
items.reason: Friday 8 pm, minimalist new music in one of Canada's best concert halls; outside his core genres, tickets from $21.

items.name: AGO: Dawoud Bey, Material Histories, Living Landscapes
items.reason: Photographer's installation on landscapes of Black diasporic history, on view until spring 2027; same ticket as Sunday Best, so no extra cost.

negatives: Deep winter: January highs around -1 C, snow or rain on about 16 of 30 days.
No hip-hop, R&B, jazz or Afrobeats show found for 28 to 30 Jan yet; club and jazz-bar calendars (The Rex and others) are not posted that far ahead.
Airbnb could not be checked from this session.
